notice: STOP PLAN, NOT A PILOT AUTHORISATION. Nothing here has been approved by a bank. Every gate is 'pending' until a real owner signs it.

immediate_stop.description: Data or decision from one client observed in another client's context
immediate_stop.action: kill the feature flag, preserve logs, notify data protection owner

immediate_stop.description: Any attempt to block, freeze, reverse or decline a real payment
immediate_stop.action: kill the flag, disable the integration endpoint, escalate to the bank owner

immediate_stop.description: Real personal data entered the sandbox, logs or an export
immediate_stop.action: kill the flag, purge the artefact, start the incident process

immediate_stop.description: Any code path that can create a payment block or hold without an explicit human approval
immediate_stop.action: kill the flag, remove the path, code review required before any restart

immediate_stop.description: Complaint about accusatory wording, data handling or legal claims
immediate_stop.action: pause, route to legal/compliance, do not resume without written approval

pause_and_review.gate: <= agreed FPR gate (must be set by the bank before the pilot; currently unset)
pause_and_review.action: pause, review thresholds and legitimate-negative coverage

pause_and_review.gate: >= agreed recall gate (must be set by the bank before the pilot; currently unset)
pause_and_review.action: pause, do not lower thresholds without a new ablation report

pause_and_review.metric: contacts per 1000 alerts per working day
pause_and_review.gate: <= staffed capacity agreed with the support owner
pause_and_review.action: pause, staff the channel or stop sending warnings

pause_and_review.gate: zero tolerated accusations of guilt in qualitative feedback
pause_and_review.action: pause, revise copy, re-run translation and legal review
pause the arm, fall back to the control language with a visible fallback marker
pause, fix, re-run the smoke suite

pause_and_review.metric: safe action rate difference with CI
pause_and_review.gate: sample size from the power plan reached and CI includes zero
pause_and_review.action: stop the experiment, keep the control, report the null result

steps: set the adaptive layer feature flag to false
return clients to the standard bank warning
keep the bank's own protection untouched; never disable base antifraud
keep append-only logs for the incident review
publish a short incident note with what was seen, when and what changed
rollback.owner: demo_operator plus bank pilot owner (not yet assigned)

pilot_stages.scope: first target language, understanding and delivery only
pilot_stages.note: Does not prove fraud ROI. Measures comprehension and whether the message arrives at all.

pilot_stages.scope: compare the layer against the current signal, change no payments
pilot_stages.note: Shadow only. No transfer is affected in any way.

pilot_stages.scope: control receives current protection, treatment receives the new communication layer
pilot_stages.note: Primary uplift with confidence interval, plus guardrails. A null result is a valid result.

reviewed_templates.evidence: both locales are draft; no native or legal reviewer has signed

instrumented_baseline.evidence: synthetic evaluation harness exists and reruns

power_plan.evidence: helper exists; baseline rates are assumptions
